law_name: Law on Personal Data Protection (Official Gazette of Montenegro 79/08, 70/09, 44/12, 22/17, 77/24)
jurisdiction: Agency for Personal Data Protection and Free Access to Information (AZLP)
applies_to: Public and private controllers and processors (unconfirmed)
key_requirements: Legal basis or consent for processing; special categories need explicit consent or legal justification; data-subject rights; agency can impose administrative fines (unconfirmed)
data_categories: Personal data; special categories (racial/ethnic origin, political and religious beliefs, trade union, health, sex life, biometric data, criminal and misdemeanour records)
enforcement_authority: Agency for Personal Data Protection and Free Access to Information (AZLP)
penalties_range: Per a third-party summary: fines of 10x to 300x the minimum wage for legal entities and 1x to 20x for responsible persons (unverified against the statute) (unconfirmed)
genetic_data: Not named in the special-categories list of the 2008 law (health and biometric data are) (unconfirmed)
notes: Sources conflict on a replacement: ppc.land reports a new 106-article GDPR-style law adopted 2026-09-04 and applicable 2027-03-19 (fines up to EUR 2M or 4% turnover); a gov.me draft bill dated 2026-08-10 was seen but no Official Gazette publication found. Treat the 2008 law as the one confirmed in force and re-check.; effective_date not found: the enactment date is used
